entities.name: Araumi
entities.description: Merfolk royalty who became Araumi, of the Dead Tide, reanimating pirates as undead thralls.

entities.name: Araumi's kingdom
entities.description: Small merfolk kingdom looted by pirates.

events.summary: Araumi runs away from home and boards a passing ship.
events.quote: She ran away from home and flagged down a passing ship.

events.summary: The human crew prove to be pirates, subdue Araumi and sail to loot her kingdom.
events.quote: Tragically, the humans on board the ship were actually pirates .

events.summary: Araumi's magic activates, dragging the pirates to their doom and reanimating them as undead thralls.
events.quote: It was then her substantial magic activated, dragging the pirates to their doom and reanimating them as undead thralls.
